Our Services

Full-service bath and kitchen remodeling — from a single fixture upgrade to a complete gut renovation. All work is permitted, warrantied, and done by our own crew.

Service

Bathroom Remodeling

From a single fixture upgrade to a complete gut renovation — we design and build bathrooms that work the way you live.

  • Full bathroom gut renovations
  • Shower & tub replacement or conversion
  • Vanity, sink & faucet upgrades
  • Tile floors, walls & surrounds
  • Lighting, exhaust fan & electrical
  • Accessibility & walk-in conversions

Service

Kitchen Remodeling

A kitchen remodel is the single biggest return on investment in your home. We make sure it's built to last and built to impress.

  • Full kitchen gut and rebuild
  • Cabinet removal, install & refacing
  • Countertop replacement — granite, quartz, laminate
  • Backsplash tile design & installation
  • Sink, faucet & garbage disposal
  • Appliance hookups & coordination

Service

Tile & Flooring

Precise tile work makes or breaks a remodel. We lay it right the first time — no lippage, no cracked grout six months later.

  • Ceramic, porcelain & natural stone tile
  • Large-format tile installation
  • Heated floor systems
  • Shower pans & waterproofing
  • Grout color matching & repair
  • LVP & hardwood transitions

Custom Cabinetry

Stock cabinets leave dead space and dated kitchens. Our custom and semi-custom options fit your space — not the other way around.

  • Semi-custom and fully custom cabinet builds
  • Soft-close hinges & drawer systems
  • Pull-out shelving & organizers
  • Island and peninsula builds
  • Bathroom vanity cabinets
  • Painted, stained & natural wood finishes
